footman.name: Grunt
footman.description: a stocky green-skinned orc warrior with a heavy jaw and small tusks, bald head with a topknot, crude leather-and-iron armor, a big cleaver-like sword and a round wooden shield with a bone rim; team-colored shoulder pads, loincloth and shield paint

peasant.name: Peon
peasant.description: a hunched skinny green orc laborer with big ears and small tusks, ragged brown tunic, carrying a crude pickaxe/tool; team-colored headband and belt

moleman.name: Sapper
moleman.description: a small green goblin digger with a huge nose, goggles and a big shovel-claw, dirty brown overalls; team-colored cap

catapult.name: Bone Catapult
catapult.description: a crude orc siege catapult of rough logs lashed with rope, bone and horn decorations, spiked wheels, a skull-shaped counterweight; team-colored banner/cloth on the frame

airship.name: Goblin Zeppelin
airship.description: a patched lumpy goblin balloon with a crude wooden gondola, propeller and exhaust pipes, stitched leather envelope; team-colored patches and flag

townhall.name: Chieftain Hut
townhall.description: a big round orc hut of logs and hides with a thatched/hide roof, tusks and horns over the door, torches; team-colored banners

fort.name: War Fort
fort.description: a sturdy orc wooden fort with spiked log walls, skull decorations and a gate with tusks; team-colored banners and roof cloth

castle.name: Great Hall
castle.description: a massive orc great hall of dark stone and huge logs, spiked roof, giant tusks framing the entrance, bone totems; team-colored roof banners

citadel.name: Stronghold
citadel.description: an imposing orc stronghold of rough dark stone blocks and spiked iron, tall horned towers, skull ornaments; team-colored flags and roof cloth

barracks.name: War Camp
barracks.description: an orc war camp building: long hide tent-hall on log frame, weapon racks, spikes and a war drum; team-colored banners

farm.name: Pig Farm
farm.description: an orc pig farm: crude log hut with a muddy pen and fat pink pigs, straw roof, bones on the fence; team-colored cloth on the roof

shed.name: Lumber Hut
shed.description: a small orc lumber hut of rough logs with a hide roof, piles of logs and a big axe in a stump; team-colored flag

manufactory.name: Goblin Workshop
manufactory.description: a noisy goblin workshop: ramshackle wood-and-scrap-metal building, chimney, gears and cogs, anvil; team-colored awning

tower.name: Watchtower
tower.description: a tall orc wooden watchtower on stilts lashed with rope, spiked platform, horn decorations; team-colored flag

cannontower.name: Skull Tower
cannontower.description: a squat orc stone-and-log defense tower topped with a giant skull and a crude cannon; team-colored banner

wall.name: Palisade
wall.description: an orc palisade wall segment of sharpened vertical logs lashed with rope, with a few bones; team-colored cloth strip
